findings.subject: service db
findings.message: db sets container_name "shop-db", so a second stack of this file cannot start
findings.hint: remove container_name; siding names containers per stack

findings.subject: network shared
findings.message: the network shared has the fixed name "everyone", which every stack of this file would share
findings.hint: remove name:, or declare it external if stacks are meant to share it

findings.subject: volume pgdata
findings.message: the volume pgdata has the fixed name "shop-pgdata", so every stack of this file would share its data
findings.hint: remove name:, or label it dev.siding.shared: "true" if stacks are meant to share it

findings.subject: service db
findings.message: db mounts /var/lib/shop from the host, and every branch's stack writes into the same directory
findings.hint: mount a path inside the worktree, or a named volume

findings.subject: service db
findings.message: db mounts /src/shop/init from the host, and every branch's stack writes into the same directory
findings.hint: mount a path inside the worktree, or a named volume

findings.subject: service db
findings.message: db has no healthcheck and no route path; the verdict only knows that it runs
findings.hint: add a healthcheck, so Ready means the service works, not only that it started

findings.subject: service tools
findings.message: tools uses network_mode "host", so siding cannot route it
findings.hint: remove network_mode to make the service reachable through the proxy

findings.subject: service tools
findings.message: tools has no healthcheck and no route path; the verdict only knows that it runs
findings.hint: add a healthcheck, so Ready means the service works, not only that it started

findings.subject: service worker
findings.message: worker has no healthcheck and no route path; the verdict only knows that it runs
findings.hint: add a healthcheck, so Ready means the service works, not only that it started

findings.subject: service db
findings.message: db publishes 5432; siding resets published ports
findings.hint: reach it through its route, or with docker compose -p shop-main exec db

findings.subject: volume cache
findings.message: the volume cache has the fixed name "pip-cache" and is shared on purpose (dev.siding.shared)

findings.subject: stack
findings.message: no service is the root of the stack's address; it answers 404 at /
